summary: First Real Estate Investment Trust of New Jersey (REIT) filed an 8-K reporting a Purchase and Sale Agreement to sell 100% of its ownership in Westwood Plaza shopping center to a Regency Centers affiliate for $28.8M total cash. The buyer deposited $1.2M refundable during a 120-day due diligence period (ending Sept. 23, 2026); after that, a $1M additional non-refundable deposit is due, and the buyer can extend due diligence another 9 months for $50K/month. The board is not explicitly recommending, though the deal is signed. No premiums, break fees, or advisors are disclosed. The closing is subject to customary conditions. Watch for completion of due diligence periods and any buyer termination rights.
